//: Type-safety gate for the website under www/. Extends the same strict config as src/, and overrides only what a site needs: the DOM.
//tsBuildInfoFile: Its own file, never the inherited one. See the note in tsconfig.json.
//types: `node` stays on, against the instinct to keep it away from browser code. www/ is one project holding two kinds of module: the VitePress config and www/scripts/ read package.json at build time, and the components run in a tab. Splitting the directory into two tsconfig projects to hide `node` from the second buys a second buildinfo and a second entry in every gate's file list, and it guards against an import Vite already fails the build on, since it cannot bundle node:fs for a browser. One project, and the bundler is the check.
//exclude: www/docs/ is the generated mirror and .vitepress/cache and dist are build output; none of the three is authored here.
